text: Nomology [Gr. nomoV , law, + logoV , doctrine]: for equivalents see the next topic. The science which investigates laws, as general psychology and general physics; contradistinguished from classificatory and explanatory science. Hamilton says, 'We have a science which we may call the nomology of mind -- nomological psychology' ( Lects . on Met ., vii). ( C.S.P. )
